title: ShadowAQP
summary: ShadowAQP is an approximate query processing system that trains conditional generative (CVAE) models on labeled table samples to answer group-by and join queries with generated tuples. Its utils/onehot_encoder.py wraps RDT's OneHotEncodingTransformer inside a custom MyOneHotEncoder class as one of several categorical-encoding options in its data preparation pipeline.
evidence: utils/onehot_encoder.py:7 'from rdt.transformers import OneHotEncodingTransformer' wrapped in class MyOneHotEncoder
needs: Could not confirm from evidence whether MyOneHotEncoder actually invokes the RDT transformer's fit/transform at runtime beyond the import and class definition.
